rows.title: Task package integrity
rows.requirement: The extracted task package passes scripts/verify_task_package.py and its external ZIP SHA-256 is recorded.

rows.title: Clean source intake
rows.requirement: The original worktree status, uncommitted changes and untracked files are captured before mutation; existing user work is preserved.

rows.title: v0.5-capable base selected
rows.requirement: The selected SACS base contains the v0.5 analysis contracts, persistence, pump, AG-UI v0.3, fixture adapter and progressive verification.

rows.title: Exact SACS source lock
rows.requirement: SOURCE_LOCK records the exact SACS repository, base branch, commit SHA and tree cleanliness.

rows.title: Exact WSGS source lock
rows.requirement: SOURCE_LOCK records WSGS main and any selected handoff branch SHA without assuming the package-generation observation is current.

rows.title: WSGS 1.1 artifact verification
rows.requirement: The authoritative WSGS 1.1 release lock and every consumed schema artifact are verified from raw bytes and SHA-256.

rows.title: Safe feature branch
rows.requirement: Work occurs on codex/sacs-v0.6-wsgs-full-functional-integration or a non-destructive equivalent; no published history is rewritten.

rows.title: Initial acceptance ledger
rows.requirement: Every acceptance row is present exactly once and initialized to NOT_RUN or NOT_REQUESTED as specified.

rows.title: Product-boundary reconciliation
rows.requirement: Root AGENTS/Codex guidance is updated so existing AG-UI/WSGS responsibilities are not contradicted while SDAR boundaries remain intact.

rows.title: Baseline verification
rows.requirement: The selected source passes the available v0.5 focused, typecheck, migration and architecture baseline or failures are explicitly recorded before implementation.

rows.title: Analysis source mode contract
rows.requirement: A strict source-mode contract distinguishes WSGS_GROUNDING_JOB, WSGS_NATIVE_ANALYSIS, FIXTURE and read-only LEGACY_PLAN.

rows.title: Truthful source identity union
rows.requirement: Source identity uses source kind/id/hash and optional source revision/run identity; Grounding IDs are not typed as plan IDs.

rows.title: Source adapter interface
rows.requirement: A single AnalysisSourceAdapter contract covers start/get/observe/cancel/revise/resolveChoice without hiding transport truth.

rows.title: Existing native behavior preserved
rows.requirement: The five existing Native WSGS analysis ports remain available behind the new abstraction and retain fail-closed authorization.

rows.title: Fixture behavior preserved
rows.requirement: The fixture adapter implements the new abstraction without becoming production eligible.

rows.title: LEGACY_PLAN read compatibility
rows.requirement: Migrated v0.5 rows can be read as LEGACY_PLAN without fabricated authority.

rows.title: LEGACY_PLAN write prohibition
rows.requirement: All new revision create/write APIs reject LEGACY_PLAN.

rows.title: Contiguous additive migration
rows.requirement: The next discovered migration number is appended contiguously and does not rewrite existing migration files.

rows.title: v0.5 upgrade safety
rows.requirement: A real PostgreSQL schema upgraded from v0.5 retains existing sessions, revisions, events and projections.

rows.title: Empty database safety
rows.requirement: All migrations install successfully into an empty PostgreSQL database.

rows.title: Repository scope preserved
rows.requirement: New source identity reads/writes require the existing principal/thread scoped repository path.

rows.title: Canonical hash determinism
rows.requirement: Source identity and request hashes are canonical, deterministic and verified on parse/write.

rows.title: Authoritative consumer lock
rows.requirement: SACS contains a READY 1.1 consumer lock only when generated/verified from the exact locked WSGS source; provisional provenance cannot be READY.

rows.title: Explicit 1.0 selection
rows.requirement: The client preserves the frozen legacy 1.0 request/response path.

rows.title: Exact 1.1 request headers
rows.requirement: Every 1.1 request sends exactly one wsgs-contract-version and one wsgs-result-profile header with the locked values.

rows.title: 1.1 response header verification
rows.requirement: The client verifies WSGS response contract/profile headers and rejects mismatch, duplication or silent downgrade.

rows.title: Caller authorization failure
rows.requirement: An unauthorized 1.1 consumer fails closed with a stable SACS/WSGS contract error and does not retry as 1.0 when 1.1 is required.

rows.title: Capability preflight
rows.requirement: Capabilities are fetched under the selected contract and parsed into required, optional-available and optional-unavailable states.

rows.title: Grounding Job adapter reuse
rows.requirement: GroundingJobAnalysisSourceAdapter uses the existing WsgsHttpClient rather than a second ad-hoc HTTP stack.

rows.title: Synchronous result support
rows.requirement: HTTP 200 Grounding results become correct terminal source snapshots.

rows.title: Asynchronous job support
rows.requirement: HTTP 202 jobs preserve groundingId/jobId and are observed through GET polling until terminal.

rows.title: All status normalization
rows.requirement: ACCEPTED, RUNNING, COMPLETED, PARTIAL, AMBIGUOUS, UNRESOLVED, FAILED and CANCELLED map deterministically.

rows.title: Bounded polling
rows.requirement: Poll interval, maximum duration, consecutive failures and response bytes are validated and bounded.

rows.title: Abort propagation
rows.requirement: Caller AbortSignal stops local waiting without falsely marking the WSGS Grounding cancelled.

rows.title: Stable idempotent start
rows.requirement: Exact canonical request + idempotency key replay returns the same operation; same key with different request conflicts.

rows.title: No guessed native routes
rows.requirement: Grounding Job mode never calls guessed Plan/Event/Revision/Intervention endpoints.

rows.title: Begin API
rows.requirement: beginWorldGrounding durably claims/replays the request and returns a truthful handle without requiring terminal completion.

rows.title: Observe API
rows.requirement: observeWorldGrounding emits truthful source transitions and supports bounded cancellation/reconnect behavior.

rows.title: Complete API
rows.requirement: completeWorldGrounding returns or safely maps the terminal WSGS result.

rows.title: answerWorld compatibility
rows.requirement: Existing answerWorld behavior remains as a wrapper and ordinary OpenAI world answers regress successfully.

rows.title: Analysis binding
rows.requirement: Grounding source identity is durably bound to exactly one authorized analysis revision/run.

rows.title: Single active pump
rows.requirement: Concurrent ensure calls result in at most one active poller per analysis revision/run.

rows.title: Semantic event deduplication
rows.requirement: Identical polls do not append duplicate business events or advance projections.

rows.title: Restart recovery
rows.requirement: STARTING/RUNNING/CANCEL_REQUESTED Grounding analyses resume after process restart from durable identity.

rows.title: Stale-run isolation
rows.requirement: Events/results for superseded revisions/runs cannot mutate the active projection.

rows.title: Terminal monotonicity
rows.requirement: Terminal source/run states cannot regress to nonterminal states.

rows.title: Cancel uncertainty
rows.requirement: Transport uncertainty leaves CANCEL_REQUESTED until WSGS proves terminality.

rows.title: Projection integrity
rows.requirement: State/activity revisions and canonical hashes remain valid after Grounding Job transitions.

rows.title: Scoped not-found
rows.requirement: Cross-principal/thread analysis access is indistinguishable from unknown analysis access.

rows.title: URI+hash schema registry
rows.requirement: Result parsing requires both authoritative schema URI and schema hash.

rows.title: 1.1 findings parser
rows.requirement: The locked WSGS geospatial findings profile parses all authoritative finding kinds.

rows.title: Source product preservation
rows.requirement: Source product IDs, authority, content/descriptor hashes, time and evidence links are retained.

rows.title: Typed gap preservation
rows.requirement: Typed gaps preserve kind, severity, message code, evidence links and safe detail.

rows.title: Unknown schema safe path
rows.requirement: Unknown URI produces UNSUPPORTED_FINDING_SCHEMA without inferred facts or geometry.

rows.title: Hash drift safe path
rows.requirement: Known URI with wrong hash is rejected/typed-gap and never parsed by shape alone.

rows.title: Bounded payload
rows.requirement: Oversized or deeply nested payloads fail safely before persistence/rendering.

rows.title: Unified view model
rows.requirement: All normalized output enters one deterministic WorldAnalysisViewModel.

rows.title: Road association semantics
rows.requirement: Road visits, off-network, ambiguity, quality breaks and suffix completeness remain distinct.

rows.title: Temporal event semantics
rows.requirement: Event type, instant/interval time, FIRST/LAST confirmation and blocking periods are retained.

rows.title: Metric ranking semantics
rows.requirement: Ranking retains metric concept, rank, actual representative visited position and unknown temporal completeness.

rows.title: Action-target safety
rows.requirement: Historical target candidates always require current validation and route planning and are not execution-authorized.

rows.title: Deterministic ordering/hash
rows.requirement: Equivalent verified source results produce the same normalized order and canonical hash.

rows.title: No provider package dependency
rows.requirement: SACS production code has no direct dependency/import on T2/T3/T4 Provider implementation packages.

rows.title: Answer projection boundary
rows.requirement: Facts, qualifiers, choices and unavailable capabilities are built deterministically before optional language polishing.

rows.title: Partial answer qualification
rows.requirement: PARTIAL results explicitly describe limited available data.

rows.title: Unconfirmed LAST qualification
rows.requirement: An unconfirmed LAST is rendered as last confirmed, not absolute last.

rows.title: No-data semantics
rows.requirement: NO_DATA is not rendered as zero or as proof of non-occurrence when coverage is incomplete.

rows.title: Road geometry non-fabrication
rows.requirement: Road IDs/names without published geometry are not turned into road lines.

rows.title: Trajectory preview non-fabrication
rows.requirement: A bounded point preview is visibly labeled bounded and is not presented as a complete trajectory.

rows.title: Off-network wording
rows.requirement: Off-network is presented as not associated with the current reference network, not as false trajectory.

rows.title: Temporal event projection
rows.requirement: Published event points/intervals map correctly to map and timeline items.

rows.title: Metric position authority
rows.requirement: The map uses representative visited position; H3 center/boundary remains auxiliary.

rows.title: Distinct timeline concepts
rows.requirement: Paused, data-gap, quality-break, off-network and ambiguity intervals remain distinct.

rows.title: WSGS timeline source
rows.requirement: Timeline can represent WSGS-organized derived findings without changing original evidence authority.

rows.title: Truthful AG-UI step
rows.requirement: Grounding Job emits only truthful coarse source/SACS stages and never fake Provider DAG/progress.

rows.title: Snapshot-before-interrupt
rows.requirement: AG-UI interrupt completion is preceded by full State and Activity snapshots.

rows.title: Reconnect recovery
rows.requirement: Reconnect, revision gap or hash mismatch requests full State and Activity snapshots.

rows.title: Legacy client regression
rows.requirement: OpenAI-compatible and AG-UI v0.2 paths remain compatible.

rows.title: Prior Grounding context
rows.requirement: Follow-up requests carry authorized prior groundingId, resultHash and selected product IDs.

rows.title: Trajectory-to-last-junction
rows.requirement: A follow-up can request the last junction from a prior trajectory via WSGS rather than local Provider logic.

rows.title: List-to-LAST rule
rows.requirement: Local selection is allowed only when the prior result is complete and deterministically contains LAST; otherwise a new Grounding is submitted.

rows.title: TopK-to-rankN rule
rows.requirement: Rank N is reused only when present in a trusted prior result; otherwise a new Grounding requests sufficient K.

rows.title: Ambiguity intervention
rows.requirement: WSGS ambiguity creates a bounded Analysis Intervention/choice set.

rows.title: Authorized choice only
rows.requirement: Choice resolution rejects candidates not published for the current ambiguity and scope.

rows.title: Choice creates new revision
rows.requirement: An accepted choice creates a new immutable revision/run/Grounding.

rows.title: Constraint change creates new revision
rows.requirement: Phase scope, threshold, time window and Top-K changes create new Groundings, not local result edits.

rows.title: No native compile in job mode
rows.requirement: Grounding Job revision paths do not invoke Native compileRevision.

rows.title: Cancel mapping
rows.requirement: User cancellation calls WSGS cancel and maps confirmed terminal status without conflating disconnect.

rows.title: Mutation fencing
rows.requirement: Proposal/cancel/intervention commands are fenced by expected revision, idempotency and one active mutation claim.

rows.title: Historical target remains non-executing
rows.requirement: Follow-up 'go to candidate' creates only an action target candidate and causes no SDAR/route/device call.

rows.title: Currentness unavailable qualification
rows.requirement: When WSGS currentness is unavailable the view remains UNKNOWN and current validation required.

rows.title: Multi-turn scope isolation
rows.requirement: Prior grounding and choices cannot be referenced across unauthorized principal/thread scopes.

rows.title: Normal-server wiring
rows.requirement: The normal SACS server composes the contract-aware WSGS client, Grounding Job source, Analysis runtime, analysisControl and AG-UI v0.3 handler.

rows.title: Persistence reuse
rows.requirement: The analysis integration reuses the existing persistence runtime/pool rather than creating a separate hidden database stack.

rows.title: Feature flags
rows.requirement: Analysis enabled/transport/contract/profile/polling/limits are strictly parsed and documented.

rows.title: Grounding Job default
rows.requirement: When analysis is enabled and no explicit transport is given, production chooses GROUNDING_JOB.

rows.title: Fixture production rejection
rows.requirement: Production startup cannot select or import the fixture adapter as a runtime path.

rows.title: Native fail-closed
rows.requirement: NATIVE mode without an authoritative eight-artifact handoff fails closed and does not guess routes.

rows.title: Dedicated analysis readiness
rows.requirement: A bounded safe capability/readiness projection reports enabled transport and optional capability state.

rows.title: Optional capability isolation
rows.requirement: Missing advanced history/selection/currentness does not make unrelated chat, task or legacy grounding unhealthy.

rows.title: Bounded telemetry
rows.requirement: Telemetry records bounded aggregate analysis metrics with no high-cardinality IDs or payloads.

rows.title: Secure logging
rows.requirement: Logs/public errors do not expose tokens, user text, geometry, safePayload, DB URLs or raw upstream bodies.

rows.title: Pump/rate limits
rows.requirement: Authenticated rate limits and internal pump limits prevent unbounded analysis work.

rows.title: Version/docs/changelog
rows.requirement: Package version, README, environment example and changelog accurately describe v0.6 and its deferred Native scope.

rows.title: Development verification
rows.requirement: All DEVELOPMENT required rows and required v0.6 commands pass with source-bound evidence.

rows.title: Real source lock refreshed
rows.requirement: Integration evidence records exact final SACS and WSGS source SHAs and verified WSGS contract hashes.

rows.title: Real services only
rows.requirement: The tested chain uses a real source-built/approved WSGS API and worker plus real persistence; no fixture/mock/recorded response supplies the result.

rows.title: Real 1.0 capabilities
rows.requirement: SACS successfully calls real WSGS legacy capabilities under the 1.0 selection.

rows.title: Real 1.1 capabilities
rows.requirement: SACS successfully negotiates real WSGS 1.1 geospatial capabilities with exact headers and authorized principal.

rows.title: Real Grounding submit
rows.requirement: A real world request is accepted by WSGS and produces a durable Grounding ID.

rows.title: Real async observation
rows.requirement: At least one real nonterminal Grounding is observed through SACS polling before terminality, or authoritative WSGS evidence proves only synchronous execution is configured.

rows.title: Real terminal projection
rows.requirement: The real WSGS terminal result updates SACS Analysis state, map/timeline/text as applicable, with matching result/projection hashes.

rows.title: Real cancellation
rows.requirement: A real in-flight Grounding is cancelled through the WSGS endpoint and SACS observes authoritative CANCELLED, or source evidence proves cancellation cannot be triggered in the isolated harness.

rows.title: Real ordinary grounding regression
rows.requirement: Reference grounding/world answer remains functional through the real WSGS chain.

rows.title: Real geospatial finding
rows.requirement: At least one real WSGS 1.1 geospatial finding/result-extension is consumed and safely presented.

rows.title: Real ambiguity/unresolved behavior
rows.requirement: A real AMBIGUOUS or UNRESOLVED case is exercised when the harness can deterministically produce one; otherwise the limitation is source-bound.

rows.title: Real road association
rows.requirement: A real WSGS-advertised road-association result is normalized and projected.

rows.title: Real temporal event
rows.requirement: A real WSGS-advertised temporal-event result, including LAST confirmation semantics, is normalized and projected.

rows.title: Real metric ranking
rows.requirement: A real WSGS-advertised metric-ranking result uses representative visited position and preserves completeness limits.

rows.title: Real advanced multi-turn
rows.requirement: A real prior-Grounding follow-up reuses authorized context for an advanced history request.

rows.title: No illegal direct connection
rows.requirement: Network/process evidence confirms SACS contacted only WSGS/SDAR and its own PostgreSQL, not Provider/upstream databases.

rows.title: Accurate conditional blockers
rows.requirement: Every unavailable conditional integration row is BLOCKED_EXTERNAL with capability/contract evidence, never silently omitted or marked PASS.

rows.title: Isolated cleanup
rows.requirement: Temporary processes, containers, ports and databases created by the integration run are cleaned without touching shared services.

rows.title: Final source-bound verification
rows.requirement: Final reports identify the exact SACS source SHA and prove the worktree used for each verification command.

rows.title: Acceptance evidence completeness
rows.requirement: Every required DEVELOPMENT and INTEGRATION row has PASS, FAIL or valid BLOCKED_EXTERNAL with an evidence reference.

rows.title: No bulk promotion
rows.requirement: Rows are not promoted to PASS merely because a broad command succeeded; evidence remains mapped per criterion.

rows.title: Final in-scope regression
rows.requirement: All v0.6, affected v0.5/v0.4, API, persistence, migration, architecture and security regressions pass.

rows.title: Production dependency audit
rows.requirement: Production build contains no fixture selection path, Provider implementation dependency or direct upstream database client.

rows.title: Final secret scan
rows.requirement: The exact final tree passes secret-pattern and sensitive-evidence checks.

rows.title: Final report truthfulness
rows.requirement: FINAL_REPORT distinguishes development, real integration, conditional blockers, release non-claims and Native Analysis deferral.

rows.title: Draft PR evidence
rows.requirement: If GitHub credentials are available, a Draft PR is created/updated with source-bound summaries and no merge action.

rows.title: Release not automatically requested
rows.requirement: Release remains NOT_REQUESTED unless the user explicitly starts it.

rows.title: No merge/tag/release/deploy
rows.requirement: The Goal performs no merge, tag, release or deployment.

rows.title: Optional release container qualification
rows.requirement: Container/SBOM/compose release qualification is run only after explicit release authorization.

rows.title: Completion marker integrity
rows.requirement: SACS_V06_GOAL_COMPLETE is emitted only when development and real-integration completion rules are satisfied; Native deferral remains stated.
